cars.specification_market: Original B110 / KB110 Datsun Sunny 1200 sporting-road family, represented by the Japan-market 1972 coupe GX-5 and its original Nissan sales leaflet. One family across sedan/coupe, GX/GX-5 grades, years and export Datsun 1200 names. The leaflet’s prominent unparenthesized 83-PS engine reference is selected; gross/net and fuel-grade certification are not inferred from the small-print alternative figures. No later B210/B310, B120 pickup, A12A/A14 engine, ordinary export single-carb output or tuned TS racing specification imported. The Nissan Heritage Collection 063 technical table is explicitly a competition car with a later engine, not road evidence: no 1298 cc, 145 PS, 638 kg, racing Solexes or racing tyres copied. No mass, dimensions, top speed, measured acceleration or uncertain gearbox ratios imported. Direct fifth and road GX-5 introduction are explicitly stated in the manufacturer’s narrative.
cars.summary: The B110 Sunny GX road family was a major foundation of Japanese small-capacity touring-car racing. Nissan documents the GX-5 coupe’s use as a race base, while its original road leaflet records a twin-carburettor A12 and close-ratio five-speed with direct fifth. This entry preserves the sporting road car; tuned TS-racer engines and results are not stock-road specifications.
